description.narrative:
International Alert's organisational strategy Partners for Peace 2024-2030 strategy sets out five goals that are summarised as "working with people directly affected by violence to support lasting solutions to conflict and build sustainable peace; and work with those people and with partners, from local to global levels, for wider changes to policies, practices and behaviours that are required for peace to be inclusive and sustainable".
The following aspects of the strategic goals are of particular interest for Sida's support:
GOAL 1: Building Peace
- Strengthening social cohesion; including reintegration of former combatants and reconciliation between previously conflicting parties; addressing sexual and gender-based violence; and engaging faith actors where relevant.
- Providing convening and external perspectives, when needed and invited to add value to locally led peace efforts or bring together actors who cannot easily meet without third-party mediation or facilitation.
GOAL 3: Integrating Peace
- We build strategic partnerships with international development and humanitarian organisations for joint programme design and delivery through country teams and local networks.
- We are expanding conflict-sensitivity integration hubs and work to embed peace-positive approaches within the programme portfolios of major development agencies and development finance institutions.
- We accompany private investors and businesses with conflict-sensitive advice and training, to advance peace outcomes in fragile settings.
GOAL 4: Making connections to advocate for global change
- We connect peacebuilders across contexts to share lessons, build coalitions and amplify locally grounded evidence in policy debates.

Stöd till International Alert om totalt 16 MSEK för perioden 2026-2027, vilket avser bidra till de övergripande målen i organisationens strategiska plan (2024-2030).
International Alert är en global icke-statlig organisation med cirka 170 anställda i 13 länder, där särskilt verksamheten i Ukraina, Syrien, Tunisien, Libanon, Etiopien/Afrikas horn och södra Kaukasus är relevant för Sida. International Alert har bidragit till positiv fred och minskat våld genom att arbeta med människor över konfliktlinjer och med alla konfliktparter i mer än 40 år. Dess huvudkontor är i London.
Beredningen visar att organisation särskilt förväntas bidra med tematiska resultat inom kvinnor, fred och säkerhet, dialog och medling, HDP nexus och privatsektorutveckling i sköra kontexter.

Support to International Alert totalling 16MSEK for the period 2026-2027, which will contribute to the overall goals of the organisation's strategic plan (2024-2030).
International Alert is a global non-governmental organisation with about 170 staff i 13 countries, where the work in Ukraine, Syria, Tunis, Lebanon, Ethiopia/Horn of Africa and South Caucasus is of particular interest to Sida. For more than 40 years International Alert has contributed to positive peace and decreased violence by engaging with people across conflict lines and with all conflict parties. Its head office is in London.
The appraisal shows that the organisation will contribute with thematic results within the areas of women, peace and security; dialogue and mediation, HDP nexus and private sector development i fragile contexts.
